PG: pg: the module the gem defines, which PG::Connection hangs off
async_exec: pg: PG::Connection#async_exec runs a statement without blocking the thread
async_exec_params: pg: PG::Connection#async_exec_params does the same with bind parameters
async_prepare: pg: PG::Connection#async_prepare stores a statement under a name without blocking
connect: pg: PG.connect and PG::Connection.connect each open a connection
exec_params: pg: PG::Connection#exec_params runs a statement with bind parameters
new: language: Ruby spells Class#new the same way. PG::Connection.new opens a connection
open: language: Ruby spells IO.open and File.open the same way. PG::Connection.open opens a connection
postgresql: suss: the store, spelled the way every provider summary spells it
prepare: pg: PG::Connection#prepare stores a statement under a name
query: pg: PG::Connection#query is the same call as exec
send_query: pg: PG::Connection#send_query sends a statement and leaves the result to be collected
send_query_params: pg: PG::Connection#send_query_params does the same with bind parameters
sync_exec: pg: PG::Connection#sync_exec runs a statement and blocks the thread
sync_exec_params: pg: PG::Connection#sync_exec_params does the same with bind parameters
sync_prepare: pg: PG::Connection#sync_prepare stores a statement under a name and blocks
